ms.report:
Thank you for taking the time to review our milestone submission.
Date of the report: May 08th, 2024
Month to report: April, 2024. 

1) The Script Address of the Treasury Contract of the deployed system must be reported, to track the funds secured in the Treasury. 

・The Script Address of the Treasury contract corresponding to the Gimbalabs Treasury is the same as provided for Milestone 1: addr1z9563wuln5hwr8yrspwx0lz030k9g6gryd8c2077qmv9tacdu706suvddaa3zf095hfjgnxfex3xuwut8m4nshyjmxfsd24ahd

・Querying the Script Address in an explorer such as Cardanoscan (on Mainnet) shows that the total balance there is 11760 ADA. That is the same amount logged by the transaction on Apr 2, 2024 12:56:19 PM; TxHash: 877c8f1f582877626db8b577a5d39e9d05a999922220143dbb70f12936ab245ac097; Amount in ADA: 11760, when the Gimbalabs Treasury was opened. So in conclusion, for the present milestone, there was no movement of funds. If the same checks performed in Milestone 1 are run again for this milestone, the above results will be produced. 

・The Gimbalabs Treasury instance, that can be accessed through the url https://gimbalabs-prototype.andamio.io/, logs 11750 ADA. That information is consistent with that gathered via Cardanoscan. 

Detail really important to consider: the Milestone 1 PoA was presented for us on April 4, 2024. At April 22th, it was approve by the Catalyst Team. However, today, May 08th, 2024, the payment corresponding to the previous Milestone has not been disbursed yet. That’s the reason why the Treasury Contract’s Script Address and the Gimbalabs Treasury instance don’t reflect additional inflow of funds.

 
2) Link to the monthly report detailing the activity that took place in the system and showing the progress of the research.

Month to report: May, 2024.

In the following spreadsheet you can track the volume of approved and paid projects. This spreadsheet is built from information queried directly in Cardanoscan, using the Gimbalabs Treasury Script Address: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nSmOmjRHuUvByAotwSmjrZ-R00ljRlf9F5wFVUnFcfA/edit?usp=sharing
Besides being able to follow the flow of funds, watching the following video (https://youtu.be/e4jiC_vIoB4?si=3blHjVgdxQYwM5Vh&t=3842) it is possible to identify how the projects in the spreadsheet are connected with the task table of the approved proposal hosted in Notion. This is exactly the kind of dialogue that occurs between the off-chain governance activity and the on-chain execution activity. 
Note: by accessing the prototype of the Gimbalabs contribution platform through the url: https://gimbalabs-prototype.andamio.io/ , you may notice that the amount of ADA in the Treasury is much lower than the amount reported in the spreadsheet. It should be remembered that this milestone is reporting activity for the month of May 2024. Consulting the Treasury script address in a explorer such as Cardanoscan will allow you to study the transactions that have taken place in June 2024.

Thank you for taking the time to review our milestone submission.
1) The Script Address of the Treasury Contract of the deployed system must be reported, to track the funds secured in the Treasury. 

The Script Address of the Treasury contract corresponding to the Gimbalabs Treasury is the same as provided for previous Milestones: addr1z9563wuln5hwr8yrspwx0lz030k9g6gryd8c2077qmv9tacdu706suvddaa3zf095hfjgnxfex3xuwut8m4nshyjmxfsd24ahd
In the following spreadsheet you can track the volume of approved and paid projects. This spreadsheet is built from information queried directly in Cardanoscan, using the Gimbalabs Treasury Script Address: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nSmOmjRHuUvByAotwSmjrZ-R00ljRlf9F5wFVUnFcfA/edit?usp=sharing
You can compare the final balance in the spreadsheet with the final balance in the Gimbalabs Contributor Platform at https://gimbalabs-prototype.andamio.io/ (Treasury where the funds are locked).

2. Report detailing the activity that took place in the system and showing the progress of the research.

We have moved the research paper to the official Gimbalabs github repo at: https://github.com/gimbalabs/research-osc-model-for-cardano-orgs/blob/main/Gimbalabs%20Research_%20Open%20Source%20Contribution%20Model%20%20for%20Cardano%20Organizations.pdf 
After months of effort and thorough data analysis, we have identified the key insights necessary to develop a contribution model tailored to the startups and projects within the Cardano ecosystem. While some additional refinement is needed in the Results and Conclusions sections of the document, it is already at a stage where it can serve as a foundation for understanding and implementing the proposed model.
Over the coming weeks, we will finalize the research paper and present it for your review and consideration.
